title: Unit Rates & Proportions
hook: Imagine using unit rates & proportions to solve a puzzle in Ratio Reef.
bigIdea: Unit Rates & Proportions helps you describe and solve number relationships. Choose the operation that matches the question, keep track of units, and check that your answer makes sense.

vocabulary.definition: A number sentence that shows the operations in a problem.
A nearby value used to decide whether an answer is reasonable.

workedExamples.problem: A 3-pack costs 6 coins. Find the cost per item.
steps: Divide total cost by number of items.
The unit rate is 2 coins per item.

workedExamples.problem: A 4-pack costs 12 coins. Find the cost per item.
steps: Divide total cost by number of items.
The unit rate is 3 coins per item.

commonMistakes: Using the wrong operation for unit rates & proportions.
Forgetting to label the answer with the correct units or simplify it when needed.
realWorld: People use unit rates & proportions when measuring, comparing, planning, and checking quantities in everyday tasks.
